hypothesis: Measured instruction counts vary only modestly with tensor dimensions. Per-prompt overhead, padded token volume, and input text length should explain that variation while distinguishing all six workload states with three features.

pcvs.name: batch_size
pcvs.rationale: Captures per-prompt tokenization, cleaning, and tensor assembly overhead.

pcvs.expression: (1 if isinstance(prompt, str) else len(prompt)) * max_sequence_length
pcvs.name: padded_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Captures encoder and embedding work proportional to padded token volume.

pcvs.expression: len(prompt) if isinstance(prompt, str) else sum((len(text) for text in prompt))
pcvs.name: prompt_characters
pcvs.rationale: Captures text-processing work and distinguishes the two workloads with identical batch size and sequence length.
